description:
PearCal is a peer-to-peer calendar app that syncs directly between devices — no server, no cloud, no accounts required.

Your calendar data never leaves your group. It lives only on the devices of the people you choose to share with, powered by Hypercore Protocol.

FEATURES

Peer Groups

Create a group and invite others via a share link or QR code. Each group has its own color and avatar. Members see only the events shared with them.

Events & Reminders

Create one-time or recurring events. Set a reminder time per event. Selectively share events with specific group members — not everyone in a group has to see every event.

Holidays
Optional US, Canada, and UK public holiday calendars. Toggle per country from your profile. Holiday events are read-only and stored locally only.

Privacy First

No account creation. No email address. No tracking. No ads. Your data stays on your devices.

Open Source
PearCal is free and open source. Source code is available on GitHub.

PERMISSIONS

Camera — used to set your profile photo and scan QR invite codes.
Photo Library — used to set your profile photo.
whatsNew:
Bug Fixes

  - Moving an event from one group to another no longer deletes it. Before this fix the event vanished from everyone else's calendar and could not be brought back.
  - Groups that had quietly stopped syncing now repair themselves the next time you open the app.
  - Deleted groups no longer linger in your group list, and empty blank rows are gone.
  - Joining a group now tells you when something went wrong. It used to sit on a blank "Inviter" card forever with no explanation, whether you had been declined or simply could not reach anyone.
  - Android: fixed a frozen screen when returning to the app after it had been in the background for a while. Taps still worked but nothing redrew.

  Security & Privacy

  - Fixed a problem where a group could lose the key that keeps its contents private. When that happened the group stopped syncing, and invites shared from that device left the key out so new members could not join properly. Affected devices now repair themselves automatically.

  Improvements

  - The invite QR code now slides up as a sheet you can swipe away, matching the rest of the app.
